event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Semis led a narrow mega-cap bounce.
SOXX +2.07% did the day's work while the equal-weight S&P managed just +0.36%, so the bounce was concentration, not conviction. Weak housing data (Sept housing starts 122.1 vs 130.5 fc, existing home contract sales -7.3% vs -0.5% fc) went unpunished, and the tape is repricing a hawkish Fed with a 100% CME hike odds into Oct 28.

INDICES — VIX 16.7, modestly above its 16.1 20-day MA.
SOXX +2.07%, QQQ +1.05%, DIA +0.64%, SPY +0.53%, IWM +0.25%. Large > small by 0.80pp. Nat gas -5.05% was the standout cross-asset move; oil -0.50% with EIA crude drawing -3.06M bbl vs -0.82M fc. No 200-DMA break to flag on SPY/QQQ.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY 0.9x, QQQ 0.9x: below-average volume into an up day = low-conviction rally.
Gainers with attention: SOXX 1.1x, XLC 1.5x (down -1.11%, so distribution), XLK 1.2x. Ignored: IWM 0.6x, IJR 0.6x, SLV 0.6x. Breadth: 58% advancers, 55% >50DMA, 54% >200DMA, up/down vol 1.18, 40 new highs vs 13 lows — participation confirms mildly but 54% >200DMA is thin for an index at highs.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLK Technology +1.67%, XLI Industrials +0.91%, XLF Financials +0.57%, XLU Utilities +0.29%, XLE Energy +0.28%, XLB Materials +0.18%, XLY Discretionary +0.03%, XLV Healthcare -0.49%, XLP Staples -0.73%, XLRE Real Estate -0.76%, XLC Comms -1.11%.
Top industries CIBR +2.72% and DRAM +3.02%; bottom KWEB -2.51% and UNG -5.05%. Flows contradict the price ranking: XLV took +$646mm (94th pctile) and XLE +$434mm (77p) while XLY bled -$422mm (6p) and XLK -$326mm (12p) — leaders being sold = short-covering in semis, not conviction. Money is moving into healthcare and energy, out of discretionary and tech. Rotation state: narrow mega-cap tape.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.23 and QQQ 1.05 = real protection demand; skew positive on both (SPY +5.1%, QQQ +7.5%).
IWM PCR 1.99 is the extreme, with gamma flip 277 vs spot near maxpain 274 — dealer hedging amplifies small-cap moves. VIXEQ 40.7 vs VIX 16.7 is a 24-point dispersion gap: a stock-picker's rotation tape, not macro-correlated.

CROSS-ASSET — Natural gas -5.05% against oil -0.50% and gold +0.34% is the odd divergence; a 5.35pp energy-complex split while crude drew -3.06M bbl says gas oversupply, not demand. Next FOMC Oct 28: CME pricing 100% hike; Polymarket has 78% for a 25bp hike after December and 97% for no cuts in 2026.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 59.8, Neutral.
NFLX -5.31% on ad-revenue guidance cut with 2.8x volume (distribution); NET +5.32% on 10M developers; PLTR +4.74%. Worst sector 20d: XLK -3.48%; best XLE +9.28%. Watch: KWEB -2.51% at 2.6x volume, IWM +0.25% with PCR 1.99 near its 277 gamma flip, and UNG -5.05% breaking 20d -8.28%.
